The '''Wookiee council''',<ref name="TEA" /> also referred to as the '''central Wookiee government''',<ref name="HoloNet" /> was the governing body of the [[Wookiee/Legends|Wookiee]] [[Species/Legends|species]] on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Kashyyyk/Legends|Kashyyyk]]. The government had developed to an advanced state prior to the arrival of the [[Czerka Arms/Legends|Czerka Corporation]] in [[4020 BBY]], who colonized the planet and renamed it Edean. After the corporation was [[Rebellion on Kashyyyk/Legends|forced]] off the world in [[3956 BBY]] Kashyyyk became a thriving world<ref name="TEA" /> and a member of the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]].

In [[22 BBY/Legends|22 BBY]], [[Senator/Legends|Senator]] [[Yarua/Legends|Yarua]] refused an offer for Kashyyyk to join the [[Confederacy of Independent Systems/Legends|Confederacy of Independent Systems]], the secessionist movement embroiled in the [[Clone Wars/Legends|Clone Wars]] against the Republic. The central government also rejected the placement of Republic military bases on Kashyyyk, in spite of [[Battle of Alaris Prime (Hunt for the Decimator)|multiple]] Separatist [[Battle on Alaris|invasions]] on the [[Colonist/Legends|colonized]] [[Moon/Legends|moon]] [[Alaris Prime/Legends|Alaris Prime]].<ref name="HoloNet" />

In [[4 ABY/Legends|4 ABY]], the Wookiee [[Chewbacca/Legends|Chewbacca]] and [[Han Solo/Legends|Han Solo]] helped rebuild the Wookiee [[Government Tree]] on Kashyyyk, to bring aid from the [[Alliance to Restore the Republic/Legends|Alliance to Restore the Republic]].<ref name="GB">''[[Star Wars: Galactic Battlegrounds]]''</ref>
